method: Opened all four native PNGs with view_image and visually inspected the rendered overview and first skill family.

screenshots.findings: Desktop windlass: two-column shortcuts and skill tiles are readable; the 2/1/2 strip agrees with the counts; earlier-setup labels remain clear.
Desktop ramp: current-skill highlight, 2/1/2 strip and checked/solution/unsaved text are readable; control labels fit.
Dark 320px screw: shortcuts and tiles stack in one column; long labels wrap; the 1/1/3 strip and current-skill border remain distinguishable.
Forced-colors 320px windlass: solid, striped and empty portions remain distinct; counts and disabled revisit reason are readable; keyboard focus and current selection are visible.
